title: Excavator work
author: Ohrwurm
changes: A real excavator at work: its diesel engine growls louder as the hydraulic arm moves, ending with a clank of the bucket. Trimmed to 54.00–56.90 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording (Tascam HD-P2, Beyerdynamic MCE82).
